parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionCode
parameters.description:
The code of the region.

>  This parameter is required if you set RegionType to region. The value is the code of the city.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: RegionType
parameters.description:
The type of the region. Valid values:

*   **operator**: the ISP.
*   **continents**: the continent.
*   **region**: the city.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-hybrid-cloud-server-regions --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-5yd00007009 --region-code 410 --region-type region --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
